title: Nintendo NBA live 95 SNES Authentic Tested Working Cartridge Only
descriptionText:
Experience the thrill of live basketball action with NBA Live 95 for the Nintendo SNES. This authentic and tested working cartridge is the perfect addition to any sports game collection. With Electronic Arts as the publisher, you know this game is of the highest quality.

This game is designed for the NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region code and was released in 1995. It falls under the category of video games and consoles and specifically, video games. Immerse yourself in the world of sports with this amazing game that will keep you entertained for hours.
